composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Idempotency gate (runs first): when the request carries an 'Idempotency-Key' already seen by a
# previous create, respond with the originally created owner and 200 OK, short-circuiting the
# pipeline so no duplicate is made. Otherwise take the 'proceed' flow into the normal create.
idempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotency
  outputs:
    hit: respondExisting
    proceed: validate

# Idempotent repeat: respond with the originally created owner and 200 OK, reusing the standard
# owner responder rather than re-mapping the DTO in the gate.
respondExisting:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner

# Validate required fields first, so a missing/blank field is a 400 listing the
# offending field names before any entity is built or persisted.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateNewOwner
  next: validateRegistrationDate

# Reject a supplied registrationDate later than the server date with a 400, before any
# entity is built or persisted. A no-op when no registrationDate is supplied.
validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateRegistrationDate
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the optional postcode against the city before any entity is built or persisted, so a
# malformed or out-of-range postcode is a 400. A no-op when no postcode is supplied.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  next: resolveHousehold

# A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode). Read-only step: derives the deterministic
# 'householdId' from the last name and postcode and publishes it for the steps below. It does
# not reject on its own. Runs before any entity is persisted.
resolveHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveHousehold
  next: uniqueIdentity

# Duplicate-detection gate: the single identity key (SHA-256 over normalized telephone,
# lower-cased email and soundex of the last name). Reject the create with a 409 when an existing
# active owner already carries the identical identity key. Runs before any entity is persisted.
uniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateUniqueIdentity
  next: cityCapacity

# Reject a create whose city already contains 50 or more owners with a 409, before any

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility and used
            when no structured 'addressLine1' is supplied. When the structured fields are
            supplied this is also returned as the composed address: the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' input
            when present. Normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST/RD/AVE).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address. When present it is normalized
            and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it is stored
            and returned, and composed into the derived salutation. Optional.
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When present it
            must be 4 digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), within that region's inclusive
            range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned
            when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it drives the derived ageBand,
            computed as of the registrationDate. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode), so a second owner
            sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode is a household duplicate and is
            rejected with 409. Set this true to bypass that duplicate block and be created as a
            declared household member; a declared member is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Owners are grouped under a householdId derived from (lastName, postcode) regardless
            of this flag.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the title and last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Who'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by spaces. The known country codes are '+61' (Australia) and '+1' (NANP); any other E.164 value is split with a two-digit country code. The raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's member ID, the single identifier unifying the former customerCode and membershipNumber. Formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region derived from the postcode and city (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN), FY is the 2-digit fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July) derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone followed by the lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the 2-digit fiscal-year segment of the memberId (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). A registration date in July-December yields the fiscal year starting that year; January-June yields the fiscal year that started the previous year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier derived from the owner's last name and postcode (the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 of normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last name and postcode share it. Owners created without a postcode have no household ID.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email segment is empty when
                absent). Duplicate detection is keyed on this single value, so a create whose
                identity key matches an existing active owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '3a1f9c8b2d4e6f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90112233445566778899'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, shared the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively). Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a household of 3 or more members; adds 3 for a tenure of one or more elapsed fiscal years since the registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the REGION prefix of the memberId (everything before its fixed <FY><HASH8><CHK> tail), which the create pipeline derives first from the postcode by range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither matches.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's timezone as an IANA name, derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (counted by registrationDate for the current business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (counted case-insensitively), approaching the hard capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's last-name soundex and postcode while carrying a different identity key, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared last-name soundex and postcode, different identity key). Absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-

                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no birthDate is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when this owner has been soft-deleted (DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags the owner deleted and retains the record), otherwise false. A newly created owner is not deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false

            selfLink:

              readOnly: true

The spec: return `riskFlag` true when **any** of these hold — the owner is a possible duplicate, the email domain is disposable-adjacent, or the city is over its soft capacity; otherwise false.

Following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection convention, I implemented it by **reusing the existing soft-signal rules** rather than recomputing them.
